title: MEG deployment diagram
description: How MEG runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no database. The browser runs the whole game and keeps progress and high scores itself; the Worker only checks the sign-in and serves the files.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the game itself and keeps its progress and high scores in localStorage.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/retro/meg*, ahead of the games hub's custom domain.

nodes.name: meg Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the sign-in check on the page; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

nodes.name: Google Fonts
nodes.description: Serves the game's three fonts; the page falls back to system fonts without them.

artifacts.name: index.html, meg.css and meg.js
artifacts.description: The page, its stylesheet, the game script and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy), copied into dist/ unchanged.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page and its assets.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): the game's page needs a signed-in player.
HTTPS: the stylesheet and font files.
